ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two side-by-side curve graphs in the figure. The y-axis of the left graph is labeled membrane potential Membrane potential (mV), with a range approximately from +20 mV to -100 mV; the x-axis is time. The initial flat segment of the curve in the left graph before the rapid rise of the action potential is located near -90 mV, then it rapidly rises to a positive value, enters the plateau phase, and then repolarizes back to a negative value. The right graph shows relative permeability curves of ions such as Na+, K+, and Ca2+. Reasoning: The question asks about the resting membrane potential of a muscle fiber, so the membrane potential graph on the left should be checked. The resting membrane potential corresponds to the initial resting stage before the action potential occurs, and this segment is closest to -90 mV on the y-axis. Therefore the resting membrane potential is -90 mV.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the figure has a membrane potential graph on the left and ion permeability curves on the right. Focus on the left graph because the question asks for membrane potential. Locate the initial segment before the sharp rise of the action potential; this is the resting phase. Read the corresponding y-axis value, which is closest to -90 mV. Therefore report the resting membrane potential as -90 mV.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有两个并列曲线图。左图的纵轴标为膜电位 Membrane potential (mV)，范围大约从 +20 mV 到 -100 mV；横轴为时间。左图曲线在动作电位快速上升前的初始平坦段位于接近 -90 mV 的位置，随后迅速上升到正值、进入平台期，再复极回到负值。右图显示 Na+、K+、Ca2+ 等离子的相对通透性曲线。推理：题目询问肌纤维的静息膜电位，应查看左侧膜电位图。静息膜电位对应动作电位发生前的初始静息阶段，该段在 y 轴上最接近 -90 mV。因此静息膜电位为 -90 mV。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct graph-reading route: identify the resting state as the pre-action-potential baseline on the membrane-potential trace and read its y-axis value.
planner_metadata.image_role: Use the left panel, which plots membrane potential (mV) versus time. Observe that before the rapid upstroke at the start of the action potential, the trace sits just above the -100 mV tick and closest to the -90 mV level.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to determine that the target quantity is the resting membrane potential of ventricular contractile cardiac muscle fibers and that the answer should be based on the graph.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Resting membrane potential is the membrane voltage before excitation/depolarization begins; on an action-potential graph it is read from the initial baseline, not from the peak or plateau.
